_help: VULPHEX's 9 AI security agents. Each wraps ONE real tool. kind=local runs on code/files you own (always allowed). kind=active reaches a target over the network and ONLY runs when the target is in scope.json AND you approve. The planner and report writer use the same uncensored model as the trading bots.

agents.name: Probe
agents.finds: known CVEs and misconfigurations on a host

agents.name: Mirror
agents.finds: jailbreaks and unsafe outputs in an LLM

agents.name: Crucible
agents.finds: prompt-injection and abuse paths in an AI app

agents.name: Ward
agents.finds: security checks that must keep passing
